caption: A woman wearing a white vest and black pants has appeared behind the meadow, with her hands on her waist, facing the tree on the left side of the picture, with her back to the waterfall. The hamburger on the right side of the picnic blanket has been replaced by two cups of red drinks.

The word 'Hushe' in blue letters, previously visible above the right side of the scene near the top of the wall, has been removed. A person wearing a white short-sleeved shirt, blue jeans, and white shoes is now present in the center of the hospital room, facing away from the viewpoint and looking toward the windows at the end of the room.

A person wearing a black hat, an orange top, black pants, and black shoes appears in the front left of the scene. She is facing the table on the left side of the scene, holding a beige coat in her right hand, with her left hand raised near her mouth. The green cabinet door at the back left of the scene has disappeared.

The wooden chair with a cushion on the left side of the scene has been moved to the right, and its orientation is now facing the table. The two large terracotta pots in the middle of the greenhouse have been reduced in size. A purple box has appeared next to the wooden bench on the left side of the greenhouse.

A person wearing a white top and blue pants has appeared on the right side of the kitchen, facing the black counter on the right. A blue sign with the word "kitchen" has appeared in front of the round table in the center of the scene. The white clock hanging on the wall at the back left of the scene has changed from brown to white. A stainless steel pot has appeared on the stove at the back right of the scene. The transparent glass goblet on the black countertop at the back right of the scene has changed color from red to yellow.

The white chair with a light beige cushion on the left side of the round table has appeared. The transparent glass water bottle on the black countertop to the left of the oven has appeared. The stainless steel oven at the rear right of the kitchen has disappeared. The blue kettle on the round wooden table in the center of the scene has changed to transparent. The two wine glasses on the black countertop at the back right of the scene have changed from yellow to transparent.

A person wearing a white vest, blue overall overalls, and a blue hat appears in the middle of the greenhouse, standing with hands on hips, facing the front of the scene. The word "Shep" in large blue letters has appeared on the ground at the front entrance of the greenhouse, positioned in front of the wooden table and chairs.

A blue and white beach chair has moved from the right side of the picnic blanket to the left side of the blanket, closer to the tree on the right. A man wearing a white vest and black pants appears behind the picture, with his hands on his waist, facing the tree on the left.

A woman wearing a yellow dress and white shoes appears on the right side of the classroom, standing near the wall, facing the left side of the classroom with her body slightly angled towards the front. The blackboard at the front of the classroom has decreased in size.
The scene has become darker. A person wearing a white T-shirt, dark pants, and white shoes has appeared in the center of the scene, facing the camera, holding a cardboard box.

The white pillow on the right side of the top bunk bed has appeared. The blue book on the cabinet to the left of the lower bed has appeared. The orange cylindrical pillow on the lower bed has appeared. The white pillow on the left side of the lower bed has appeared. The color of the rectangular cushion on the floor below the lower bed has changed from yellow to orange.

The man wearing a hat, a yellow coat, and blue pants, who was on the left side of the screen, facing away from the picture with his back to the camera and a backpack on his shoulders, is no longer visible. The bicycle that was leaning against the right fence in front of the red house has moved to the center of the road.
